push.title: L 4-5 vs UK Chargers | You: 8.4 (4th best match performance)
push.body:
An 8.4 from BellyTb1, your 4th best match performance. That's a good night's work.

THE GOOD
+ A brace against UK Chargers. Cool head, quick feet, ball in the onion bag.
+ 0.6 over your usual. Keep the elevator going up.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 1. Keep that in your back pocket.
+ Best passes attempted of your 3 matches this session (21). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Here's the deal: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. We'll get there together.
- 62% passing (13 of 21, down from your usual 75%). Easy money: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle. You've got this.
- 5 goals conceded dinged you 0.1. Fixable by Thursday.
- Key passes: 0. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 2+. That's the next rung.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. I'm not pointing fingers. I'm pointing at the mirror, mine included.

Rep it: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

BellyTb1, from me to you: A good teammate is like a good umbrella. You don't notice 'em till it rains.

Let's do it again tomorrow. - Coach Lasso

An 8.2 against UK Chargers, PhogsToffees. Your 5th best match performance. Sturdy work.

THE GOOD
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. That's patience and aim, the dynamic duo.
+ 2 key passes. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ You and BellyTb1 linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ Missed tackles 0, down from your usual 2. Little things like that are big things in disguise.
+ 0.4 up on your average. Momentum is a wonderful thing.

THE BAD
- Pass accuracy: 80%. The bar for top forwards is 88%+. Go clear it.
- Shots: 2. Next target: 3+.
- A one-goal loss (4-5): a single moment decided it. That's the bill for the little mistakes, and we all chipped in.

Backyard drill: Live on the last defender's shoulder and time the run as the passer lifts their head.

PhogsToffees, take this with you: Be curious about your game, not cruel to it.

Champions have off days too. - Coach Lasso
